تمتلكوا (form VIII)
# تَمْتَلِكُوا (tamtalikū) /tam.ta.li.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# تُمْتَلَكُوا (tumtalakū) /tum.ta.la.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
